response.original_title: [{(!@!Major® Guide!!)}] How do I add a second room on my MSC cruise?
response.overview: To add a new room to an existing MSC Cruises booking, you must book a separate cabin by contacting :: +1[844]375[4179] (USA) or :: +44[808]196[9697] (UK) MSC Cruises or your travel agent directly, as separate rooms cannot be added online. For connecting rooms, it is best to call 1[844]375[4179] or use a travel agent to ensure the cabins are adjacent.
